title: airDash contributor and operator capstone
summary: Deliver a small reviewed change and diagnose an operational incident while preserving security, data, and recovery boundaries.

artifacts.title: Problem statement and non-goals
artifacts.evidence: A concise Markdown path or note.

artifacts.title: Source-to-side-effect trace
artifacts.evidence: Paths, symbols, route, tables, and audit action.

artifacts.title: Controlled implementation
artifacts.evidence: Branch and diff or commit hash.

artifacts.title: Canonical documentation update
artifacts.evidence: Changed documentation paths and maintenance triggers.

artifacts.title: Security, data, deployment, and rollback analysis
artifacts.evidence: Threat boundary, data invariant, change class, and rollback.

artifacts.title: Incident diagnosis exercise
artifacts.evidence: Symptom, hypotheses, read-only evidence, correction, and verification.

rubric.description: Defines the user problem, requirements, non-goals, and evidence standard.
Uses the shell, reproducible tools, and Git workflow safely.
rubric.evidence: Tool versions, branch, status, and specific staging evidence.

rubric.description: Explains the relevant JavaScript, TypeScript, dependency, build, and HTTP mechanics.
rubric.evidence: Own-words source explanation and request trace.

rubric.description: Preserves API authorization, validation, parameterized data access, transactions, and database invariants.
rubric.evidence: Handler and data-model review with invariant proof.

rubric.description: Places the change in the correct component and preserves architecture, repository, and domain lifecycles.
rubric.evidence: Component diagram or trace and lifecycle analysis.

rubric.description: Preserves provider, notification, browser, automation, and simulator-package boundaries where applicable.
rubric.evidence: Integration impact analysis or explicit not-applicable proof.

rubric.description: Adds deterministic tests or smoke evidence and diagnoses failures from observations.
rubric.evidence: Test diff, validation output, and one interpreted failure.

rubric.description: Identifies assets and trust boundaries, prevents secret exposure, and states incident escalation.
rubric.evidence: Security review and clean secret scan.

rubric.description: Classifies deployment, verifies operations, and provides backup, rollback, and recovery procedures.
rubric.evidence: Change classification, checklists, and recovery decision.

rubric.description: Creates a reviewable contribution and explains the exact scope and limits of mastery evidence.
rubric.evidence: Pull request draft, review record, and evidence-limit statement.
